title: Exodus 3:18-20 — three days' journey; God will stretch out His hand and strike Egypt
summary: Exodus 3:18-20 in English: the elders of Israel are to ask Pharaoh for a three days' journey into the wilderness to sacrifice to the LORD, and God says He will stretch out His hand and strike Egypt with miracles. The letters of 'LORD' and 'God' are multicoloured.

text.text: 18 “They will pay heed to what you say; and you with the elders of Israel will come to the king of Egypt and you will say to him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. So now, please, let us go a 3 days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.’
19 “But I know that the king of Egypt will not permit you to go, except under compulsion.
20 “So I will stretch out My hand and strike Egypt with all My miracles which I shall do in the midst of it; and after that he will let you go.

uncertain: Purpose of the multicoloured letters in 'LORD' and 'God' is not stated on the slide
